why: 4.9a 'A person's Start on a concluded team' + 'A concluded team is never members down (concluded wins): its seats are idle with nothing live, and its Start closes them': the close runs under the wrap-up check, so an idle seat with unpushed work is not closed and the start is refused naming it; a seat with something live is a standing seat and is left.
No Kill cure is offered anywhere: 4.9a 'A refused Start says why' offers only Close on the card, or 'wait for X, or Wind down'; the claim about what a kill stops is never made.

4.9a 'A refused Start says why': a person's own session is offered 'Close <name> on its card' when idle and clean; a suspended or non-crew holder 'keeps today's holder words' and is in neither part of the cure; every other crew holder (a live sat-out member or worker extra among them) gets 'wait for X, or Wind down'; with no cure part 'a refusal whose holders are all outside the crew ends with their words'.

4.9a 'The order is fixed': closes run only on a concluded team, 'otherwise' seats are set aside unclosed and the pairing 'then runs', where a running orphan refuses; 4.9 'a Start while an orphan still runs (the team not concluded) is refused' - so the orphan refusal comes with nothing closed.

4.9a: a seat's extra is a standing seat, left whatever its state and never a holder; the result and toast list only `left`, 'which may be fewer than the confirm named, since a live seat's extra ... is left with no create skipped', and 4.9 write_extras 'a filled one runs on' - so an extra turning busy mid-start is left and shown nowhere in the result.
